INTERNAL_ERROR.title: Internal server error
INTERNAL_ERROR.detail: An unexpected error occurred. Contact support with the request ID.

VALIDATION_ERROR.title: Validation failed
VALIDATION_ERROR.detail: One or more request fields are invalid.

AUTH_MISSING_CODE.title: Missing authorization code
AUTH_MISSING_CODE.detail: The Google callback did not include an authorization code.

AUTH_INVALID_STATE.title: Invalid authentication session
AUTH_INVALID_STATE.detail: The authentication session is invalid or expired. Please sign in again.

AUTH_DENIED.title: Authorization denied
AUTH_DENIED.detail: Google authorization was declined. Please sign in again.

AUTH_SCOPE_REQUIRED.title: Gmail permission required
AUTH_SCOPE_REQUIRED.detail: Please sign in again and grant permission to read Gmail.

AUTH_EXCHANGE_FAILED.title: Authentication failed
AUTH_EXCHANGE_FAILED.detail: Unable to complete authorization with Google. Please sign in again.

AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.title: Invalid stored credentials
AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID.detail: Stored Gmail credentials cannot be read. Please reconnect your account.

HTTP_ERROR.title: Request failed
HTTP_ERROR.detail: The request could not be completed.

HTTP_401.title: Authentication required
HTTP_401.detail: Authentication is required to access this resource.

HTTP_403.title: Permission denied
HTTP_403.detail: You do not have permission to access this resource.

HTTP_404.title: Resource not found
HTTP_404.detail: The requested resource was not found.

HTTP_405.title: Method not allowed
HTTP_405.detail: This HTTP method is not supported for this resource.

validation.invalid.detail: This field has an invalid value.
